user.title: Connect Clash Royale War Tracker
user.description:
1. Sign in to the [Clash Royale War Tracker developer portal]({developer_portal}) and create an API token.
2. Add Home Assistant’s public internet IP address to the token’s allowed IP addresses. The token is bound to those IP addresses; update it if your public IP changes.
3. Paste the token and your in-game player tag below.

Polling defaults to 5 minutes and can be changed in Options. See [setup help]({help_url}).

reauth_confirm.title: Replace API token
reauth_confirm.description: Create a replacement API token in the [Clash Royale War Tracker developer portal]({developer_portal}) and allow Home Assistant’s public internet IP address. Tokens are IP-bound. Enter the replacement below; your existing player tag and options are retained. See [setup help]({help_url}).

error.invalid_tag: Enter a valid player tag using only 0289PYLQGRJCUV, with an optional # prefix.
error.invalid_interval: Choose a whole number of minutes from 1 to 60.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key and try again.
error.ip_not_allowed: This key does not allow Home Assistant’s public IP address. Update its IP allowlist in the developer portal.
error.player_not_found: No player was found for this tag.
error.rate_limited: The provider has requested a cooldown. Wait before trying again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Clash Royale War Tracker. Try again later.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Choose a whole number of minutes from 1 to 60. Provider cooldowns still apply to manual refreshes and reloads.

error.invalid_interval: Choose a whole number of minutes from 1 to 60.
